milestones.outcome: From a Returned pull request the author opens a local draft on their worktree and sees every review conversation as an item with a place and a disposition.
exit_criteria: Address feedback opens or creates the associated local draft only on a verified worktree, and changes nothing in it.
Items come from unresolved conversations and reviews with summaries, are identified by conversation, and are placed on candidate lines only when the mapping carries them unchanged.
Dispositions are private, and the whole area is usable with no agent.
milestones.boundary: Reading and organising only: no agent run and no publication. Needs the local draft shell and pull request association of RFC-BPR-0108 and RFC-BPR-0111 first.

milestones.outcome: The author has an agent evaluate every item, fix the ones they accept in one run, and draft the replies.
exit_criteria: Evaluation proposes and the author disposes; nothing is accepted automatically.
Reviewers' text is quoted data in every brief and cannot change what is run or granted.
One change run fixes the accepted items without committing, with changes kept or reverted per file and attributed to items as a claim.
Replies are drafts; a reply naming a commit not on the branch is refused at publication.
Evaluation and reply drafting each have their own built-in prompt.
milestones.boundary: Nothing is posted, resolved or marked Done by an agent. Needs RFC-BPR-0115's change runs and RFC-BPR-0110's local-draft sessions first.

milestones.outcome: One press pushes the commits and then posts the replies, and Home stops calling the pull request the author's move once the reviewers have been asked again.
exit_criteria: The plan is exact and finite; push precedes replies; a failed push posts nothing.
A partial failure resumes only the remainder and never posts a reply twice.
Nothing is resolved or requested that the author did not tick.
A changes-requested pull request reads Waiting once every requesting reviewer has been asked again and no conversation awaits the author.
RFC-BPR-0098's live text is reconciled with that change.
milestones.boundary: No commit, force push, merge or approval action. Needs RFC-BPR-0114's Push first. Usable with replies written by hand, so it does not wait on agent-feedback-work.
